newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Closing GBL share trade cancelled - bourse.
newsitem.headline: Closing GBL share trade cancelled - bourse.

text.p: The closing trade in Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL) stock on the Brussels bourse was cancelled at the request of the exchange's surveillance committee because of an unusual price fall, the bourse said.
"There was one share sold at the close and a fall of 15 francs in the price," a bourse spokeswoman told Reuters. "The last trade has been cancelled."
She could not say if the decision to annul the trade was in any way related to the fact GBL published earnings after the close of trading.
GBL announced group net profit rose 12 percent and said it say a higher full year 1996 full year profit.
The last trade took the share price to 3,835, down 10 francs on the day. The rectified close puts the price at 3,850 francs.
